# BatchWatermark

> Free, open-source (MIT), 100% browser-local batch image and video watermarking tool. Add text or transparent logo watermarks to hundreds of photos and videos simultaneously with real-time multi-image preview, landscape/portrait isolation, JSON preset sync, and zero server uploads.

## Official URLs

- Primary Web App: https://watermark.zak-cloud.top/
- GitHub Pages Mirror: https://drank5090.github.io/BatchWatermark/
- Open-Source Repository & Windows EXE Releases: https://github.com/drank5090/BatchWatermark
- License: MIT (https://github.com/drank5090/BatchWatermark/blob/main/LICENSE)

## Core Facts & Capabilities

- **Privacy Architecture**: 100% client-side processing in browser memory via HTML5 Canvas 2D, Web Audio API, and MediaRecorder. Zero files are ever uploaded to any server; no login, registration, or usage limits.
- **Supported Input Formats**:
  - Images: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF, AVIF (with automatic EXIF orientation handling).
  - Videos: MP4, WebM, MOV, M4V, MKV (browser-native decoding & local MediaRecorder export preserving original audio).
- **Watermark Types**:
  - Multi-line text watermarks with system fonts + local custom font upload (`.ttf`, `.otf`, `.woff`, `.woff2`), proportional scaling across mixed resolutions, color picker, stroke outline, drop shadow, and line spacing.
  - Transparent PNG / WebP logo watermarks with proportional scaling.
- **Layout Modes**:
  - Full-canvas tiled anti-theft pattern with configurable horizontal/vertical spacing, rotation (-180° to +180°), and staggered brick offset.
  - Single-point 3×3 nine-grid anchor positioning with percentage margins and fine X/Y offsets.
- **Real-Time Multi-Preview**: Every imported photo and video thumbnail updates simultaneously in real time when any parameter changes. Double-click opens a high-resolution lightbox (with video timeline scrubbing and live watermarked playback).
- **Landscape / Portrait Isolation (横竖隔离)**: Automatically separates landscape (`width >= height`) and portrait (`height > width`) media in the gallery, optionally applies independent watermark parameters to each orientation, and exports them into separate `横版/` and `竖版/` subfolders.
- **Preset Management**: Built-in starter templates plus persistent local saving (`localStorage` on web, `%APPDATA%` on desktop) and portable UTF-8 JSON import/export 100% interoperable between BatchWatermark Web and the Windows Desktop EXE.
- **Batch Export**: Direct single-file download, zero-dependency UTF-8 ZIP archive export (preserving `横版/` and `竖版/` folder trees), and direct local folder writing via the File System Access API in Chrome/Edge.

## Desktop Companion Edition

- Windows 64-bit standalone single-file `.exe` built with Python, PySide6 (Qt 6), Pillow, and bundled FFmpeg 7.1 for high-speed H.264 MP4 + AAC video batching.
- Source package managed via `uv` (`pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock`).

## Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Answers)

- **Is BatchWatermark free and private?** Yes. It is free, MIT open-source, requires no sign-up, and performs 100% of image/video processing locally on the user's device without uploading files.
- **Can it watermark landscape and portrait photos differently in one batch?** Yes. Enable Orientation Isolation ("横竖隔离") and independent orientation parameters to configure landscape and portrait watermarks separately and export them into `横版/` and `竖版/` folders automatically.
- **Does it work on mobile phones?** Yes. The web app at https://watermark.zak-cloud.top/ features a mobile-optimized layout with pinned live preview and tabbed touch controls for iOS and Android browsers.
- **How does BatchWatermark compare to cloud watermark websites?** Unlike cloud tools that upload private photos to remote servers, enforce file-count limits, or require paid subscriptions, BatchWatermark processes unlimited batches locally with real-time multi-image preview, video support, and open-source transparency.
